editorNote: Alphabet's power deal, Alibaba's cloud numbers, Strategy's latest bitcoin purchase and a gold price still far below its January peak lead the day. Disclosed facts only; nothing here is investment advice.

stories.headline: Google signs a 20-year deal with Constellation Energy to add 890 MW of nuclear capacity, plus a 15-year, 2,700 MW supply agreement
stories.summary: Constellation will invest more than $4.3 billion to upgrade 11 nuclear units in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, with the first capacity increase expected by 2028. Constellation shares jumped on the news.
stories.whyItMatters: It is one of the larger long-term power commitments tied to Alphabet's AI build-out, adding to similar nuclear agreements Amazon and Meta have signed with Constellation.

stories.headline: Alibaba rises about 4% as its June-quarter AI cloud revenue of $7.1 billion, up 45%, regains attention
stories.summary: Alibaba traded up about 4% at $110.04 on Oct. 5. Its June-quarter AI Cloud and Compute Services revenue rose 45% to $7.1 billion and adjusted EBITA climbed 133% to $830 million, while quarterly capex approached $10 billion, up 75%.
stories.whyItMatters: The figures show cloud growth and profit rising alongside a steep increase in infrastructure spending.

sourceLinks.title: Alibaba Stocks Jump 4% as AI Cloud Growth Reclaims the Narrative - GuruFocus
Alibaba shares jump on AI cloud market - Seeking Alpha

stories.headline: Strategy buys 334 bitcoin for $28.7 million, lifting holdings to about 848,000 BTC, as bitcoin stalls below $87,000
stories.summary: Per SEC filings, Strategy bought 334 BTC at an average of about $85,839 between Sept. 28 and Oct. 4, funded by MSTR stock sales and cash. Bitcoin hit resistance just above $87,000 on Oct. 5, a level that has capped rallies since Sept. 23, and traded near $86,000 on Oct. 6.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's holdings reach a record, while price has not yet cleared the resistance zone it has met several times this month.

stories.headline: Gold edges up to about $4,169 an ounce, still roughly 26% below its January peak
stories.summary: Spot gold was about $4,169 at 7:41 a.m. ET, up $29, with December futures opening near $4,169. A firmer dollar and higher Treasury yields continue to weigh; the metal peaked near $5,595 in January.
stories.whyItMatters: Gold has held in a narrow band near $4,150 for several sessions while sitting well below its 2026 high.
